lead: K. J. Yesudas has built a public profile as an Indian playback singer, born on 10 January 1940 in Fort Kochi.
As of 2026, he is 86 years old, and his birth date places him under the Capricorn sign.
He has 51 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Sangeet Natak Akademi Award and Padma Bhushan.
The sections that follow break down K. J. Yesudas's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: K. J. Yesudas — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: K. J. Yesudas was born on 10 January 1940 in Fort Kochi, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Augustine Joseph.
He studied at Swathi Thirunal College of Music and St John De Britto Anglo-Indian High School.
He is recorded as speaking Malayalam, Tamil and English.

sections.heading: K. J. Yesudas — Career and Professional Work
paras: K. J. Yesudas works primarily as a playback singer, recording artist and composer.
